using pii = pair<int,int>;

const ll INF_FLOW = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap;
    Edge(int t, int r, ll c) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c) {}
};

struct MaxFlow {
    int N, S, T;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> level, it;
    MaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t), g(n), level(n), it(n) {}
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll c) {
        g[u].push_back(Edge(v, (int)g[v].size(), c));
        g[v].push_back(Edge(u, (int)g[u].size()-1, 0));
    }
    
    bool bfs() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[S] = 0;
        q.push(S);
        while(!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for(auto &e : g[u]) {
                if(e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[T] != -1;
    }
    
    ll dfs(int u, ll pushed) {
        if(u == T) return pushed;
        for(int &i = it[u]; i < (int)g[u].size(); i++) {
            Edge &e = g[u][i];
            if(e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                ll tr = dfs(e.to, min(pushed, e.cap));
                if(tr > 0) {
                    e.cap -= tr;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += tr;
                    return tr;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    ll maxFlow() {
        ll flow = 0;
        while(bfs()) {
            fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
            while(ll pushed = dfs(S, INF_FLOW)) flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

int pos[MAXN][MAXN], distZ[MAXN][MAXN], distS[MAXN][MAXN];

void fillDistZ(int i, int j, vector<string>& grid, int n, int d) {
    if(i<0 || i>=n || j<0 || j>=n) return;
    if(!isdigit(grid[i][j]) && grid[i][j] != 'Z') return;
